title: Sync-3: Professional AI Lip-Sync by Sync Labs
summary: A 16-billion-parameter AI model designed for high-fidelity video lip-syncing with 4K output and emotion preservation. It uses a zero-shot architecture to synchronize any audio with any face, including profile shots and obstructed views.
research_notes: Developed by the original authors of Wav2Lip; offers an official Adobe Premiere Pro integration and enterprise API supporting 95+ languages.

evolution.summary: Following the academic success of Wav2Lip, Sync Labs released Lipsync-2 in 2024 and the flagship Sync-3 in April 2026. The latest version features native 4K super-resolution, obstruction detection, and a global scene understanding model.
